narrative.coaching_note: Lávese las manos con alcohol en gel a los 8.1 segundos después de tocar bed rail A y antes de tocar phone. Ese es el cambio más importante en este video. Usted tocó bed rail A con bare hand a los 1.6 segundos y la contaminación pasó a su mano. A los 8.1 segundos esa contaminación llegó a phone. Después, a los 21.4 segundos, usted tocó a resident A con bare hand sin hacer higiene de manos antes y la contaminación también llegó a resident A. Hacer higiene de manos a los 8.1 segundos hubiera interrumpido esa cadena antes de que llegara a resident A. Con esa higiene a tiempo usted hubiera mantenido limpios bare hand, gloved hand, phone y resident A.
narrative.audit_summary: Staged clip with MRSA source bed rail A. Bare hand contacted bed rail A at 1.6s, transferring contamination to bare hand, then to call button at 7.6s, to phone at 8.1s, and to resident A at 21.4s, resulting in one resident exposure of resident A. Hand hygiene compliance was 0 of 2 opportunities: Moment 5, 0 of 1 at 8.1s before handling phone after patient surroundings contact, and Moment 1, 0 of 1 at 21.4s before touching resident A. No hygiene events occurred and no glove use issues were recorded. Contamination persisted on bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, phone, and resident A at end. Disinfect phone, bed rail A, call button, and resident A area with Use an EPA List H registered disinfectant (effective against MRSA).
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene for Moment 5 at 8.1 seconds.
